source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 28 (PDF 178-185), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 28 (Chromatography) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Which of the following is NOT one of the simple techniques named for separating one or two components from a simple mixture?
(Simple mixture se aik do components alag karne ki simple techniques mein se kaun si shamil NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Simple mixture ke liye filtration, distillation aur solvent extraction jaisi simple techniques kaafi hain; complex mixture ke liye chromatography jaisi advanced technique chahiye (28.1).

book_ref.quote: Separating one or two components from a simple mixture needs simple techniques

blocks.prompt:
2 Chromatography separates the components of a complex mixture on the basis of their:
(Chromatography complex mixture ke components ko kis buniyad par alag karti hai?)

options.text: do mukhtalif phases ke liye mukhtalif affinity (kashish)
aik phase mein mukhtalif melting points

blocks.explanation: Chromatography components ko do mukhtalif phases ke liye un ki mukhtalif affinity (kashish) ki buniyad par alag karti hai (28.1).

book_ref.quote: based on their varying affinities for two different phases

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of these is given as an example of a complex mixture that can be separated by chromatography?
(In mein se kaun si misaal complex mixture ki di gayi hai jo chromatography se alag ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phoolon ke dyes, paani mein pollutants (aaloodgi) aur patton se dawai ke extracts complex mixtures ki misaalein hain (28.1).

book_ref.quote: Complex mixtures, such as dyes in blooming flowers, pollutants in a water body

blocks.prompt:
4 Use of chromatography allows all of the following EXCEPT:
(Chromatography se yeh sab kaam hote hain SIWAAYE:)

options.text: aik element ko doosre mein badalna

blocks.explanation: Chromatography se substances ki pehchan, safai aur miqdaar maloom hoti hai (28.1); is se aik element doosre mein nahi badalta.

book_ref.quote: allows for the identification, purification, and quantification of substances

blocks.prompt:
5 Activated charcoal is used in filters and purification systems because it:
(Activated charcoal filters aur purification systems mein kyun istemal hota hai?)

options.text: gases aur impurities ko apni satah par adsorb karta hai
paani mein sab impurities hal karta hai
har gas se chemical reaction karta hai
impurities ko poore andar barabar absorb karta hai

blocks.explanation: Activated charcoal gases aur impurities ko apni satah (surface) par adsorb karta hai; adsorption satah ka amal hai (28.1).

book_ref.quote: Adsorption is a surface phenomenon in which particles accumulate only on the outer surface.

blocks.prompt:
6 Which of the following is NOT among the three important types of chromatography named in the chapter?
(Chapter mein di gayi chromatography ki teen ahem qismon mein kaun si shamil NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Teen ahem qismein paper chromatography (PC), thin layer chromatography (TLC) aur gas chromatography (GC) hain (28.1).

book_ref.quote: Among many types of chromatography, the three important types are:

blocks.prompt:
7 In paper chromatography, the stationary phase is:
(Paper chromatography mein stationary phase (thehra hua phase) kya hai?)

options.text: paper ke cellulose mein phansa hua paani

blocks.explanation: Paper mein cellulose ke saath paani juda hota hai; yehi paani stationary phase hai (28.2).

book_ref.quote: The piece of paper used in chromatography contains water combined with cellulose of the paper.

blocks.prompt:
8 In paper chromatography, the sample spot is applied:
(Paper chromatography mein sample ka spot kahan lagaya jata hai?)

options.text: paper ke neeche baseline par, capillary tube se

blocks.explanation: Sample ka chhota spot capillary tube se paper ke neeche ke qareeb base line par lagaya jata hai (28.2).

book_ref.quote: A small spot of the sample is put on the base line near the bottom of the paper by capillary tube.

blocks.prompt:
9 The separating principle of paper chromatography depends on:
(Paper chromatography ka alag karne ka usool kis par mabni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alag karne ka usool components ki relative solubility (nisbati hal-pazeeri) par hai (28.2).

book_ref.quote: The separating principle depends on relative solubility of the components.

blocks.prompt:
10 In paper chromatography, a component that is more soluble in the solvent than in the water of the paper will:
(Paper chromatography mein jo component paper ke paani se ziyada solvent mein hal hota hai woh:)

options.text: paper par ziyada upar jaye ga
neeche solvent mein chala jaye ga
solvent front se bhi upar chala jaye ga

blocks.explanation: Jo component solvent (mobile phase) mein ziyada hal ho woh paper par ziyada upar jata hai (28.2).

book_ref.quote: Some are more soluble in the solvent (mobile phase) moving up the paper.

blocks.prompt:
11 Colourless substances on a chromatogram are made visible by:
(Chromatogram par be-rang substances ko kaise nazar aane wala banaya jata hai?)

options.text: paper ko itna garam karna ke jal jaye
ink se un ki shakal banana
locating agent spray kar ke jo rang de

blocks.explanation: Be-rang substances par locating agent spray kiya jata hai jo un ko rang de deta hai (28.2).

book_ref.quote: Chromatography is used to separate both coloured and colourless substances.

blocks.prompt:
12 A component travels 2.4 cm while the solvent travels 6.0 cm from the baseline. Its Rf value is:
(Aik component baseline se 2.4 cm aur solvent 6.0 cm chalta hai. Is ki Rf value kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rf = substance ka faasla / solvent ka faasla = 2.4 / 6.0 = 0.40 (28.2).

book_ref.quote: is calculated by dividing the distance traveled by the component with the distance travelled by the solvent.

blocks.prompt:
13 A dye has Rf = 0.65 in a solvent. If the solvent front is 8.0 cm from the baseline, the dye spot is at:
(Aik dye ki Rf = 0.65 hai. Agar solvent front baseline se 8.0 cm par ho to dye ka spot kitne faasle par hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Substance ka faasla = Rf × solvent ka faasla = 0.65 × 8.0 = 5.2 cm (28.2).

book_ref.quote: is calculated by dividing the distance traveled by the component with the distance travelled by the solvent.

blocks.prompt:
14 The unit of Rf value is:
(Rf value ka unit kya hai?)

options.text: koi nahi, kyun ke yeh do faaslon ki ratio hai

blocks.explanation: Rf ka koi unit nahi kyun ke yeh do faaslon ki nisbat (ratio) hai (28.2).

book_ref.quote: Rf has no unit because it is ratio.

blocks.prompt:
15 The Rf value of a substance stays the same when:
(Kisi substance ki Rf value kab same rehti hai?)

options.text: koi bhi solvent kisi bhi temperature par ho
same solvent aur same temperature istemal hon

blocks.explanation: Same solvent aur same temperature par Rf value nahi badalti (28.2).

book_ref.quote: The Rf value of a substance does not change under same conditions (same solvent and same temperature).

blocks.prompt:
16 One advantage of chromatography stated in the chapter is that it:
(Chapter mein chromatography ka aik faida kya bataya gaya hai?)

options.text: sirf rangeen substances ke liye kaam karti hai
mixture ki bohat thori miqdaar istemal karti hai
is mein solvent bilkul nahi chahiye

blocks.explanation: Chromatography ka aik faida yeh hai ke is mein mixture ki bohat thori miqdaar lagti hai (28.2).

book_ref.quote: One advantage of using chromatography is that it consumes very small quantity of the mixture.

blocks.prompt:
17 The stationary phase of a TLC plate is made from:
(TLC plate ka stationary phase kis cheez se banta hai?)

options.text: paani mein bhigoya hua filter paper
coiled column mein long-chain hydrocarbon liquid
glass slide par sukhayi gayi alumina (Al₂O₃) ya silica (SiO₂) ki slurry

blocks.explanation: Alumina ya silica ko paani mein mila kar slurry banti hai, glass slide par phaila kar oven mein sukhaya jata hai; yeh safed solid layer stationary phase hai (28.3).

book_ref.quote: alumina (Al₂O₃) or silica (SiO₂) is mixed in water to make slurry

blocks.prompt:
18 After spreading the slurry on the glass slide, the layer is:
(Glass slide par slurry phailane ke baad layer ke saath kya kiya jata hai?)

options.text: oven mein sukha kar safed solid layer banayi jati hai
ninhydrin mein dubo di jati hai
solvent mein hal kar di jati hai
paani se dho di jati hai

blocks.explanation: Layer ko oven mein sukha kar slide par safed solid layer banayi jati hai (28.3).

book_ref.quote: This layer is dried in an oven to make a white solid layer (stationary phase) on the glass slide.

blocks.prompt:
19 Which statement about spotting samples on a TLC slide is correct?
(TLC slide par samples ke spot lagane ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Har slide par sirf aik sample lag sakta hai
Aik hi slide par mukhtalif jagahon par aik se ziyada samples lag sakte hain
Spot solvent level se neeche lagaya jata hai
Baseline solvent chalne ke baad banayi jati hai

blocks.explanation: Aik hi glass slide par mukhtalif jagahon par aik se ziyada samples ke spot lag sakte hain (28.3).

book_ref.quote: More than one samples can be spotted at different places on the same glass slide.

blocks.prompt:
20 In TLC with a polar stationary phase and a non-polar solvent, a non-polar substance will:
(Polar stationary phase aur non-polar solvent wali TLC mein non-polar substance:)

options.text: sab se ziyada mazbooti se adsorb hoga
slide par ziyada upar jaye ga (Rf bari)
polar substances se ahista chale ga

blocks.explanation: Non-polar substances non-polar solvent mein ziyada hal hote hain is liye slide par ziyada upar jate hain (28.3).

book_ref.quote: On the other hand, non-polar substances are more soluble in the non-polar solvent, and they move more up the slide.

blocks.prompt:
21 The solvent front in chromatography is:
(Chromatography mein solvent front kya hai?)

options.text: pencil line jis par sample lagta hai
woh sab se ooncha nuqta jahan tak solvent pohanchta hai
sab se tez component ka spot

blocks.explanation: Solvent front woh sab se ooncha nuqta hai jahan tak solvent pohanchta hai (28.3).

book_ref.quote: Solvent front, the highest point reached by the solvent, is marked.

blocks.prompt:
22 In TLC, the components of a sample are identified by:
(TLC mein sample ke components ki pehchan kaise ki jati hai?)

options.text: un ki Rf values ko standard values se mila kar
glass slide ka size naap kar
sookhi slide ka wazan kar ke
tank mein solvent ki gehrai naap kar

blocks.explanation: Spots ki Rf values nikal kar standard values se milayi jati hain aur components pehchane jate hain (28.3).

book_ref.quote: By comparing these Rf values with standard values, the components present in the sample are identified.

blocks.prompt:
23 Ninhydrin spray is used in TLC to make colourless amino acids appear:
(TLC mein ninhydrin spray be-rang amino acids ko kis rang ka bana deta hai?)

options.text: sirf UV light mein chamakne wala

blocks.explanation: Ninhydrin spray be-rang amino acids ko purple (jamni) rang deta hai (28.3).

book_ref.quote: Ninhydrin spray give purple colour to colourless amino acids.

blocks.prompt:
24 Some colourless substances on a TLC plate turn brown when exposed to:
(TLC plate par kuch be-rang substances kis ke saamne bhoore ho jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch be-rang substances UV light mein chamakte hain aur kuch iodine vapours se bhoore ho jate hain (28.3).

book_ref.quote: some turn brown with iodine vapours

blocks.prompt:
25 On a TLC slide, the solvent front is 7.0 cm and a spot is at 4.9 cm from the baseline. The Rf value of the spot is:
(TLC slide par solvent front 7.0 cm aur aik spot baseline se 4.9 cm par hai. Spot ki Rf value kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: TLC is faster than paper chromatography.

blocks.prompt:
26 Which of these is NOT an application of TLC given in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun si TLC ki application chapter mein NAHI di gayi?)

options.text: industrial products ki bari miqdaar mein separation
mitti, paani aur khanay mein pesticides dhoondna

blocks.explanation: TLC purity check, reaction ki progress aur pesticides ka pata lagati hai; bari miqdaar ki separation ke liye munasib nahi (28.3).

book_ref.quote: TLC identify unknown compounds by comparing their Rf values with standard known values.

blocks.prompt:
27 TLC can show the progress of a reaction by showing whether:
(TLC reaction ki progress kaise dikhati hai?)

options.text: reactants khatam huay ya products bane

blocks.explanation: TLC se pata chalta hai ke reactants khatam ho rahe hain ya products ban rahe hain (28.3).

book_ref.quote: The progress of reaction whether reactants are consumed or products are made, can be checked by TLC.

blocks.prompt:
28 In the food industry, TLC is used to check the presence of:
(Food industry mein TLC se kis cheez ki maujoodgi check ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Food industry mein TLC se preservatives, colourants (rang) aur sweeteners ki maujoodgi check hoti hai (28.3).

book_ref.quote: presence of preservatives, colourants, sweeteners in food can be checked by TLC.

blocks.prompt:
29 In forensic science, TLC is used to identify:
(Forensic science mein TLC kis ki pehchan ke liye istemal hoti hai?)

options.text: sirf sheeshe par ungliyon ke nishan
jurm ki jagah par drugs, dhamakay ka malba, khoon, paseena aur semen

blocks.explanation: Forensic science mein TLC se jurm ki jagah par drugs, dhamakay ka malba, khoon, paseena waghera pehchane jate hain (28.3).

book_ref.quote: TLC is useful in forensic science where it is used to identify drugs, post blast debris

blocks.prompt:
30 Regarding the amount of a substance, TLC is:
(Substance ki miqdaar ke lehaz se TLC kya hai?)

options.text: zyada tar qualitative; miqdaar ka sirf andaza deti hai
miqdaar ke liye GC se ziyada durust

blocks.explanation: TLC zyada tar qualitative (kaifiyati) technique hai aur miqdaar ka sirf andaza deti hai (28.3).

book_ref.quote: TLC is mainly a qualitative technique and can only give an idea about the amount of a substance.

blocks.prompt:
31 Two compounds have Rf values 0.52 and 0.54 in a solvent. On TLC their spots will most likely:
(Do compounds ki Rf values 0.52 aur 0.54 hain. TLC par un ke spots ghaliban:)

options.text: solvent front se aage nikal jayenge

blocks.explanation: TLC qareebi Rf values wale compounds ko saaf alag nahi kar sakti (28.3).

book_ref.quote: TLC cannot clearly separate compounds having close Rf values.

blocks.prompt:
32 The reproducibility of TLC is reduced because it is sensitive to:
(TLC ki reproducibility (dobara wohi nateeja) kis wajah se kam hoti hai?)

options.text: nami (humidity), temperature aur kaam ki jagah ki safai

blocks.explanation: TLC nami (humidity), temperature aur safai ke liye hassaas hai, is liye reproducibility kam hoti hai (28.3).

book_ref.quote: This technique is sensitive to humidity, temperature and cleanliness of working environment

blocks.prompt:
33 Gas chromatography is used to separate:
(Gas chromatography kin cheezon ko alag karne ke liye hai?)

options.text: gases, volatile liquids aur gas shakal mein solids

blocks.explanation: GC gases, volatile (jaldi bukhaar banne wale) liquids aur gas shakal mein solids alag karti hai (28.4).

book_ref.quote: Gas chromatography (GC) is used to separate gases, volatile liquids and solids (in gaseous form).

blocks.prompt:
34 Which gas is used as the mobile phase (carrier gas) in GC?
(GC mein mobile phase (carrier gas) ke tor par kaun si gas istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: GC mein mobile phase helium ya nitrogen jaisi inert gas hai (28.4).

book_ref.quote: In GC, the mobile phase is an inert gas (carrier gas) such as helium or nitrogen.

blocks.prompt:
35 In GC, the stationary phase is:
(GC mein stationary phase kya hai?)

options.text: silica ya alumina zarron par non-volatile, long-chain, non-polar hydrocarbon liquid

blocks.explanation: Stationary phase aik non-volatile, lambi chain wala, non-polar hydrocarbon liquid hai jo silica ya alumina ke chhote zarron par juda hota hai (28.4).

book_ref.quote: non-polar hydrocarbon liquid having high boiling point bonded to small particles of silica

blocks.prompt:
36 Which is the correct order of the path of a sample in a gas chromatograph?
(Gas chromatograph mein sample ke raaste ki durust tarteeb kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sample injector port mein dala aur bukhaar banaya jata hai, phir column se guzarta hai, aur aakhir mein detector se (28.4).

book_ref.quote: The sample is injected into injector port, where sample is quickly vapourised by an oven.

blocks.prompt:
37 The column in GC is packed with tiny silica particles because they:
(GC ka column chhote silica zarron se kyun bhara hota hai?)

options.text: carrier gas se reaction karte hain
un ka surface area bara hai jis par separation hoti hai
sample ko poora hal kar dete hain

blocks.explanation: Column mein chhote silica zarre hain jin ka surface area (satah ka raqba) bara hai, is par separation hoti hai (28.4).

book_ref.quote: long-coiled column packed with tiny silica particles having large surface area over which separation occurs

blocks.prompt:
38 In GC with a non-polar stationary liquid, a non-polar substance (of similar volatility to the others) is carried through the column:
(Non-polar stationary liquid wali GC mein (milti julti volatility wala) non-polar substance column se kaise guzarta hai?)

options.text: tez, kyun ke interact nahi karta
ahista, kyun ke stationary phase se ziyada interact karta hai
bilkul nahi; injector mein hi rehta hai

blocks.explanation: Non-polar substances non-polar stationary liquid se ziyada interact karte hain is liye column mein ahista chalte hain (28.4).

book_ref.quote: Therefore, these non-polar substances are carried through the column more slowly.

blocks.prompt:
39 Retention time in GC is:
(GC mein retention time kya hai?)

options.text: kisi substance ko column se guzarne mein lagne wala waqt

blocks.explanation: Kisi substance ko column se guzarne mein jo waqt lagta hai woh retention time hai (28.4).

book_ref.quote: The time taken by a substance to pass through the column is retention time.

blocks.prompt:
40 In GC, the graph on which the detector records separated substances as peaks is called a:
(GC mein jis graph par detector alag huay substances ko peaks ki shakal mein record karta hai use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Column se nikalte substances detector chromatogram naam ke graph par peaks ki shakal mein record karta hai (28.4).

book_ref.quote: they pass through a detector which identify and record them as peaks on a graph called a chromatogram

blocks.prompt:
41 Which is a feature of gas chromatography?
(Gas chromatography ki khoobi kaun si hai?)

options.text: ziyada sensitivity, achi resolution, tez analysis aur durust miqdaar

blocks.explanation: GC mein ziyada sensitivity, achi resolution, tez analysis aur durust miqdaar hai (28.4).

book_ref.quote: Gas chromatography has high sensitivity, good resolution, fast analysis and accurate quantification.

blocks.prompt:
42 A GC peak (treated as a triangle) has a base of 0.8 cm and a height of 5.0 cm. Its area is:
(GC ki aik peak (triangle samajh kar) ki base 0.8 cm aur height 5.0 cm hai. Is ka area kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peak ka area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 0.8 × 5.0 = 2.0 cm² (28.4).

book_ref.quote: The peaks are similar to triangles, therefore, the area of peak can be calculated by the following formula.

blocks.prompt:
43 A mixture of three esters A, B and C gives peak areas 12, 18 and 30 units. The percentage of ester A is:
(Teen esters A, B aur C ke mixture ki peak areas 12, 18 aur 30 units hain. Ester A ki percentage kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: The percentage of an ester A in the mixture of three esters A, B and C

blocks.prompt:
44 Three narrow peaks of similar base width have heights 18, 30 and 12 mm. The percentage of the component giving the 30 mm peak is about:
(Milti julti base width wali teen tang peaks ki heights 18, 30 aur 12 mm hain. 30 mm peak wale component ki percentage taqreeban:)
blocks.explanation: Milti julti base width par height istemal hoti hai: 30 / 60 × 100 = 50% (28.4).

book_ref.quote: If the peaks are very narrow or have similar base widths then peak height is used instead of area

blocks.prompt:
45 In sports, GC is used to check:
(Khel mein GC se kya check kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: GC se khiladiyon mein steroids ki maujoodgi check hoti hai aur car racing ke fuel ke components test hote hain (28.4).

book_ref.quote: GC is used to check the presence of steroids in competing athletes.

blocks.prompt:
46 Forensic laboratories frequently use gas chromatography to perform:
(Forensic laboratories gas chromatography se aksar kya test karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Forensic labs GC se blood alcohol content (BAC) test aur ghair qanooni drugs aur zeher ka pata lagati hain (28.4).

book_ref.quote: It is frequently used to perform blood alcohol content (BAC) tests.

blocks.prompt:
47 In the food industry, GC can detect spoilage by identifying:
(Food industry mein GC kharabi (spoilage) ka pata kis cheez se lagati hai?)

options.text: bacteria ya fungi ke metabolic byproducts

blocks.explanation: GC bacteria ya fungi ke metabolic byproducts pehchan kar kharabi ka pata aankh se nazar aane se pehle laga leti hai (28.4).

book_ref.quote: It can detect spoilage by identifying metabolic byproducts of bacteria or fungi

blocks.prompt:
48 In clinical settings, GC helps to diagnose metabolic disorders by analysing compounds in a patient's:
(Clinical settings mein GC mareez ki kis cheez ke compounds dekh kar metabolic bimariyon ki tashkhees karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: GC mareez ki saans ya peshaab (urine) ke compounds dekh kar metabolic bimariyon ki tashkhees karti hai (28.4).

book_ref.quote: used to diagnose metabolic disorders by analysing specific compounds in a patient

blocks.prompt:
49 Proteins and polymers cannot be analysed by GC because they:
(Proteins aur polymers GC se analyse kyun nahi ho sakte?)
blocks.explanation: Proteins aur polymers jaise bare biomolecules aasani se bukhaar nahi bante, is liye GC se analyse nahi hote (28.4).

book_ref.quote: Large biomolecules like proteins and polymers cannot be analysed by GC because they do not vaporise easily.

blocks.prompt:
50 A compound that decomposes when heated strongly is unsuitable for GC because GC samples must be:
(Jo compound tez garmi se toot jaye woh GC ke liye munasib nahi, kyun ke GC ke samples ko:)

options.text: paani mein na hal hone wale

blocks.explanation: GC ke samples thermally stable (garmi par qaim) hone chahiye; garmi se toot jane wale compounds istemal nahi ho sakte (28.4).

book_ref.quote: Compounds that decompose at high temperatures cannot be used.

blocks.text: 28.5 Comparison of Three Types of Chromatography

blocks.prompt:
51 According to the comparison table, the principle of TLC is:
(Comparison table ke mutabiq TLC ka usool kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table ke mutabiq paper chromatography: partition, TLC: adsorption + solubility, GC: partition (gas-liquid) (28.5).

book_ref.quote: Comparison of three types of chromatography

blocks.prompt:
52 In which type of chromatography is the mobile phase a gas?
(Kis qisam ki chromatography mein mobile phase gas hai?)

options.text: Both paper and thin layer chromatography

blocks.explanation: Mobile phase paper aur TLC mein liquid, GC mein gas hai (28.5).

book_ref.quote: Comparison of three types of chromatography

blocks.prompt:
53 Arrange the three types of chromatography from slowest to fastest according to the comparison table:
(Comparison table ke mutabiq teeno qismon ko sab se ahista se sab se tez tarteeb dein:)
blocks.explanation: Raftaar: paper ahista, TLC tez, GC bohat tez (28.5).

book_ref.quote: Comparison of three types of chromatography
